dina: Heads-up: postmortem actions keep piling up and some teams report "stale" items for months. I sketched a small process to tighten ownership, add reminders, and surface recurring signals. dropping the gist below.

marco: nice. can you paste the checklist?

dina: sure, short & actionable: 

```
- T+24h: owner assigned (primary + backup) + immediate remediation tags (rollback required? yes/no)
- T+72h: remediation scoping doc (what will change, tests, rollback plan)
- T+7d: progress update (CI status, PRs, blockers) 
- T+21d: QA/regression signoff + ops playbook edits
- T+45d: closure review and follow-up ticket triage (verify metrics)
Recurring rule: if same failure signature appears 2x within 60d => escalate to SRE lead + schedule "pattern-hunt" session with product and infra.
```

tara: recommend adding an "exec sponsor" field on the 24h assign. helps unblock cross-team resource requests.

aaron: can we auto-create the followup tickets with labels + owner via incident-bot? saves manual setup.

incident-bot: yes — we can scaffold followups. sample command: `/incident followup create --owner @dina --backup @marco --due 7d --tags remediation,postmortem`

kevin: dashboard idea: small "remediation velocity" tile showing open actions, median days to assign, overdue % (red >14d), and recurrence rate. PMs should get a CSV export for customer updates.

dina: agreed. also a small UX change: Console should show "open postmortem actions" alongside incident timeline for any incident with >1 followup.

marco: for IC rotation, propose 1 week IC + named backup, rotate across teams. also add a "followup duty" 48h handoff: newest IC covers immediate followups for two days post-incident to avoid owner confusion.

tara: if we enforce backups, we can avoid work stalling when owners are OOO. add a lightweight SLA: assign owner within 24h, move to backlog after 45d if no progress and notify exec sponsor.

aaron: what metrics will we track in the pilot? suggest: % actions assigned within 24h, median time-to-close, repeat-incident count by signature, and % overdue actions.

dina: pilot plan: 6-week pilot with current oncall rotation. I'll coordinate runbook updates and weekly digest posts. goals: reduce time-to-assign to <24h and overdue rate <10%.

kevin: I'll build the dashboard tile and CSV export. We'll wire a webhook so incident-bot posts followup reminders to the channel and DMs owners at 72h and 14d.

incident-bot: Pilot kickoff scheduled: Mon 2024-12-09 09:30 PST. It will DM owners at T+24h, T+72h, and at 14d for overdue actions.

marco: one more thing: add a monthly "pattern-hunt" review in the ops calendar — 60min to review recurring signals and assign an RCA sprint if needed.

dina: thanks — I'll update the runbook, create the followup scaffolds, and post the short checklist in #eng-oncall. tagging volunteers: kevin for dashboard, aaron for bot wiring, tara for SLA language.

aaron: happy to wire the bot. I'll post the command docs and sample CSV header: `incident_id,action_id,owner,backup,created_at,due_at,status,signature_tag`.

kevin: noted. will prototype tile by next Thu and iterate.

dina: great. if no objections I'll start the pilot and post a kickoff note + calendar invite. :rocket:
